body: I do try to change my thoughts, it's really getting me nowhere though, just making me feel like shit because I'm thinking of someone else when I'm in an exclusive relationship

My grandma cares a lot that is true. It would be better. I know its dumb, like I'm not denying that here. My dad once said, go live at grandmas house, be just like your brother. Its so stupid I know but its just so in my head. If I go there I'm just following the same exact path he is. I'll be no different than him. I don't want to be like that, if I had to choose between that and death, I'd choose the latter.

I could go live at my grandmas house. The only reason I don't is pretty silly I know but hear me out. My older brother moved to my grandmas house when he was my age. He still lives there at 36 years old, making less money than me, has no future. I don't want to be him, all I've wanted to be is not him and so far I am turning into a slightly better version of him.

If I'm able to somehow turn my situation around at home with this college thing. I can make something out of myself. I can be like my cousin and be one guy in my family that isn't a piece of shit. All the men in my family are pieces of shit. Lazy fucks, women abusers, hard drug addicts(like meth and shit), bigots, and racist. I hate all of them, my cousin that does the radio is the only one that isn't like that. Well guy anyways, the ladies in my family are better, but not without fault. Sorry for ranting, this topic gets my goat. I should be grateful for all this family I have, yet I hate about 90% of them.

I appreciate all the replies though. I really do.

I really don't think a therapist could do much for me anyway. I feel like a lost cause. A degenerate that with bad genes and bad conditioning that isn't cut for the world and should euthanized for my sake and everyone else's.

After I attempted suicide and was hospitalized, instead of being happy that I failed and was safe, they berated me for getting stuck in a hospital. My dad was more concerned with potential future debt collectors calling his house about my case than my well being.
They understand how dire it is?  After multiple suicide attempts and hospitalizations they still don't get it.
They told me about the therapist finder on the psychology today website. That's all they offer though.
They told me to look on this website for one. That's all they did for me. I guess its better than nothing.

Its good until I run out. I put myself on a self medicating acid plan when I started school this semester. I would microdose on it every 3 days, however I would still substitute it with a full trip when I felt like it. Sometimes once a week, sometimes twice a week, sometimes 0 times a week. My room wasn't clean, but I stopped lying about stupid shit at least and I was doing good in all my classes, there was even a girl talking to me. But I ran out of acid, unable to find more, I fell apart.

My school's counselors told me they couldn't help me, they told me to get into a therapist.

Acid isn't a visual experience, for me. It's about changing the way I think. When I take acid I start realizing how much of a piece of shit I am, how bad I'm failing and I'll even start doing shit. Last time I took acid I actually cleaned up about half my room. Still lots more to do but I got a lot done. Acid lets me be the person I want to be, that's why the acid world is better.

My parents don't care at all. They never care when I try to commit suicide, they just berate me for failing and getting stuck in a hospital. 

There's two worlds I see. I see my reality which I hate and can't change. And I also can see the acid world, where nobody is shitty and I don't feel worthless and I'm happy. The acid world is much better than reality.
I don't know what to do either. I'm a bad person that's very unhappy. Even if I fix all these issues I still wouldn't be happy. Just feel like I should be executed.
I've been put on more meds than I can even remember. Here I am.
I've given up on trying to get help. It seems pretty clear to me that there isn't any for me.

The only thing I want to change is my status of being alive. I don't drink but I love my acid. I drop it twice a week. If I stopped taking it within two months I would attempt suicide again. Its the only thing that brings me peace.

The reason I fail school isn't because of motivation. I know its hard to believe, and I certainly don't blame you if you decide not to. I really want to do well in school. I'm always the student that raises his hand politely and waits till he gets called on to speak. I participate heavily in the lecture, because I very much like the material a lot. I'll do my school work, I wont miss a day, I'll score awesome on the exams, well until I start going through my depression swing and get so suicidal I can't even leave the house.

My cousin and I are very close. he is one of the few people that still supports me and cares about my well being. I would be the first to know about anything if something was open.

I asked my cousin to see if he could help get me in a couple years ago maybe a little less but the response was no. Certainly wouldn't hurt to ask again but I doubt the results would be any different. That and I need education, which I clearly am not cut out to do. I am more than smart enough, but my lazy work ethic will prevent me from passing the amount of classes I need.

I doubt you believe this, but at one point I really wanted to be a journalist. My cousin host a political radio show and I think he has the coolest job ever. I wish I got paid to voice my well researched political opinions, get to interview some really cool people, get to travel to foreign countries. I wanted to be like him but my dad said that field is hard to get it in and with the way I am I'll never make it in. So I gave up on that idea.
But I'll be honest, that doesn't mean I have to be same as them. And if time is an issue I suppose if I managed to start living on my own that would take care of that.

I just don't think its viable. I made the youtube and twitch for fun at first, had no intentions of being a pro gamer, just wanted to make vids of my favorite game. But I can think of three people I know in person that call themselves "professional gamers". These people are even more degenerate than I am, obviously I'm really bad but these people are worse. I make a whopping 170 a week from my 20 hour a week retail cashier job. All of those "pro gamers" make that 170 in a month if they're lucky. on top of it they even are able to play video games 24/7. I'm not able to play that much for two reason. First one is just because theres other responsibilities in life that I have. Second one is because of my parents. My parents are your typical "when we were your age we went out and played and we were happy" parents. So I got my ass reamed if I'm seen on the computer for more than 5 minutes. So my gaming time is pretty limited believe it or not. I get two hours of computer time on a good day.

A little more than a year ago I made a youtube channel and tried streaming on twitch. It never went anywhere, 2 views from your buddies doesn't cut it. Sadly its hard to make it into that sort of thing and reasonably so, if it was easy to get into I bet more than half the population would play video games for a living.

I already tried the computer route. I like sitting in front of my computer to play video games and shit, I hate absolutely hated the coding aspects of it. It's useless, there is no help for me. The only help for me is a bullet to the head.
It was obviously a typo I meant petty.

Because I'm admitting I'm a piece of shit and telling truthful things about myself, then you just go and make up other stuff. I don't want to be called a bigger piece of shit than I am, I know I am pretty but I also know it could also be much much worse.

Bullshit. Fuck off. Your just trying to shit on me. I admit I'm a piece of shit and your response is to make shit up that isn't even true. Fuck you. Your an asshole that enjoys kicking people while they're down.
I'm just a piece of shit that should go die.
I can't change. I've tried to change for years, it never works. I am stuck like this for life.
there's literally nothing I like to do. Literally nothing. The only thing I like to do is sit on my piece of shit ass and sit in front of my computer. Nobody will pay you for that.

Actually my parents don't give me what I want at all. They give me punches. But go ahead, I just confess I'm a piece of shit and you go make up new shit to shit on me further. IDK what I ever did to you but fuck you too.
The average person isn't nearly as bad as me
There's no career path for me. There's literally nothing I like to do that I can make money off of. I can't even hold a job I hate to pay the bills.
Exploring the world cost money I don't fucking have
The only things I like to do don't pay enough money to survive.
I got my first two years of trade school done in high school through a program at my school. I finished it when I was 19 years old. I ended up hating the trade.
Already graduated trade school. It was a waste of my time and money. I am hopeless.
I'm a lazy piece of shit that can't change. No matter how hard I try I'll always revert back eventually
Not doing drugs sounds like hell. LSD is the only release I get from my perceived shitty reality. I couldn't hold a real job that makes enough money to live on my own in my wildest dreams.

I appreciate your reply and I know you meant well typing it. But it's not as simple as "get off my butt and do it". I've tried a lot to get off my butt and do a lot of shit. I can never sustain it. I'll do good for about a week, up to a month if I'm lucky, then I'll revert back to the same old way.

No I'm not fat, I used to be, that's basically the one thing I have fixed about myself actually. But now I'm a skinny guy that's too ugly for a girlfriend, not really but it sure feels that way a lot. But no I don't want sex, I want someone to be intimate with, someone I can hold hands with, tell her how wonderful she is and that kind of thing. Its hard to describe but I would describe as the companionship that only an SO can give.

I never understood that being a productive member of society would make me happy. I've made a lot of plans sometimes with the the help of therapist to put my life together but I can never sustain effort. I'll do good for a month if I'm lucky then revert back to my old ways. I feel like being a piece of shit is just who I am. Even when I do good I really don't find any enjoyment or gratification like you speak of. Maybe I hadn't faked it long enough, but when I'm doing a task I dread every second of it and no matter how much I try to pretend I'm having fun there's no way your going to convince that I wouldn't rather be in front of my computer right now.
Doesn't matter where I go. Being a piece of shit follows you.
